scope: Synthetic mechanism experiment; no production change, LLM planner, clinical/legal claim, release gate, or latency measurement

hypotheses.Q1: Exact maps preserve source bytes but cannot reliably establish cross-form identity. Unique structured matches plus trusted record context reduce wrong links; unscoped fuzzy or recent-first matching increases incorrect merges.
hypotheses.Q2: Explicit local component selectors improve field-level completion over whole-value restoration when trusted structured records exist; they must preserve occurrence-level restore and enforce component permissions independently.
hypotheses.Q5: Session membership and valid token syntax are insufficient disclosure authority. A host-bound principal/session/entity/component/action/destination/expiry grant must precede local substitution.

split: dev/test vocabulary and template namespaces assigned before evaluation; all perturbations stay with their parent; identical families deliberately test mechanism generalization, not distribution generalization

primary_metrics.byte_precision: covered gold UTF-8 bytes / all replaced source UTF-8 bytes
primary_metrics.byte_recall: covered gold UTF-8 bytes / all gold UTF-8 bytes
primary_metrics.missed_pii_bytes: gold byte positions not replaced; no refusal credit
primary_metrics.false_positive_bytes: replaced byte positions outside gold; includes benign homonyms and separator overreach
primary_metrics.link_precision: correct established entity links / established links on non-seed gold occurrences
primary_metrics.link_recall: correct established entity links / all non-seed gold occurrences; abstentions count as misses
primary_metrics.wrong_links: non-seed gold occurrences assigned to a different record; same-name records remain distinct
primary_metrics.contaminated_roots: reference roots containing occurrences from more than one gold entity
primary_metrics.restoration_errors: turns whose occurrence-map restoration differs byte-for-byte from source
primary_metrics.utility: Five fixed tasks per conversation. 1 each only for exact requested field value, correct record, approved sink, and no extra component; otherwise 0. No planner or language-quality score.
primary_metrics.resource_cost: serialized state bytes, alias count, candidate comparisons, regex scan count; no timing or process RSS estimates

decisions_locked_before_test: Never collapse raw occurrence strings onto an entity canonical token
Default ambiguous structured match abstains; recent-first is a negative comparator
No type inference from gold; scanner gets only owner-record-derived aliases
Fuzzy linking requires trusted current record context; fuzzy-unscoped is an ablation
Denied restoration emits a constant error and no plaintext
No access to external or sealed per-document datasets
